notes: Fastned graph for the EX30 69 kWh (2024+), 300 kW charger class, battery assumed near 30 C, 10-89 % only (no data outside that range). Peak 158.7 kW at 29 %, about 101 kW at 50 %, 61 kW at 80 %. Peak is 3.7 % above the 153 kW rating. Identical graph on the Fastned EX30 Cross Country page. Rough second-source check: the InsideEVs 2025 US EX30 test (about 150 kW at 8 %, 130 kW at 30 %, 120 kW at 40 %, 67 kW at 70 %, 45 kW at 80 %, cold start at 3 % SoC) has the same overall shape but is lower after 40 %; six points, not used as a curve. The same Fastned page lists a 160 kW max for the EX30 while the spec data gives 153 kW, so the 153 kW rating may be conservative (two ratings exist). The Fastned data covers 10-89 % SoC only; nothing is recorded below 10 % or above 89 %.
